lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice choosing an option based on a simple condition using det beror på and om.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Deciding between two plans when weather, time, or cost may change.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining that a decision depends on a practical condition.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik decide between two practical plans, but the choice depends on time, weather, or price.

main_focus.name: condition-based choice with det beror på and om
main_focus.description: Use det beror på to introduce uncertainty and om plus present tense for a realistic condition.
model_examples: Det beror på om det regnar.
Om biljetten är för dyr, tar vi bussen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use condition-based choice language naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: unreal or second conditional with skulle

useful_chunks: Det beror på om vi hinner.
Om det regnar, stannar vi inne.
Om det blir för dyrt, väljer vi något annat.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use common condition chunks that are useful for everyday planning.

dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss the condition that will decide the choice and compare practical consequences.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree when or how the final decision will be made.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat det beror på and om clauses without moving into advanced hypotheticals

focus: when or how the final choice will be made

sentence_focus: one sentence with det beror på vädret
one sentence with det beror på om
one sentence with om det regnar
one sentence with om plus a price condition
one sentence saying the decision will be made later
